scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible without a full DFT toolchain; the paper's gold values provide the authoritative reference for trend verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for adsorption energy, C-O bond length, OCO angle, CHO free energy change, and HER free energy change for each surface, extracted from Table 1 and Fig. 3 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 and Fig. 3 of the source paper; adsorption energy of Cu(111) is 0.0 (described as weakly bound).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values were transcribed directly from the paper text and table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values are the exact reported numbers from the peer-reviewed paper.

schema.description: Array of results for the five surfaces (Mo2B2, Cr2B2, Fe2B2, Mn2B2, Cu(111)). Each entry has the six required keys.

outputs.description: Contains the reproduction targets for each catalyst surface. The hidden checker evaluates four qualitative trends: (1) adsorption energy ordering (Mo2B2 most negative, then Cr2B2, then Mn2B2/Fe2B2, Cu(111) least negative); (2) O-C-O angles on MBenes significantly < 180°, on Cu(111) ≈ 180°; (3) CHO free energy increase lower on Mo2B2 and Cr2B2 than on Fe2B2, Mn2B2, Cu(111); (4) HER free energy more negative (weaker activity) on Mo2B2 and Cr2B2 compared to Fe2B2, Mn2B2, Cu(111).

output_contract.notes: Scoring is based on qualitative trend correctness, not exact numeric agreement, because the agent uses a different DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO) than the original VASP.

steps.description: Verify that the reported values satisfy the four required qualitative trends (adsorption energy ordering, OCO angle activation, CHO free energy order, HER free energy order) with respect to the hidden gold reference.
